text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-east-1 — error rate ~7% over baseline. Pager sent to leo_oncall. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/p1-generic

leo_oncall: @incident-bot acknowledged. I'm on it :rotating_light:

emma: joining warroom, pulling recent deploys and error trends

leo_oncall: created war room: https://meet.internal/warroom/1772468101 — pinning this thread there, owner=leo_oncall

infra_sre: quick snapshot: latest deploy inference-runtime-3 finished ~03:12 UTC. Seeing spike in kv_cache_miss and grpc 500s on worker-2. sample log:
```
2026-03-17T03:14:05Z worker-2 inference-runtime ERR request_id=abc123 grpc: code=Unknown message="failed to read cache"
```

rachel_pm: @leo_oncall assigning incident owner to you for ops and customer comms. Initial customer impact: intermittent failures for text generation endpoints in us-east-1, affecting a subset of production traffic. No chargeback impact known yet.

sam_support: Draft customer notification (for approval): "We are investigating intermittent 500 errors impacting text generation in US-East. Our team is actively working to mitigate. We will update every 30 minutes or when we have substantive progress." Approve? :speech_balloon:

leo_oncall: approved. I'll post to status page once we have rollback progress. Mitigation plan: rolling back inference-runtime-3 on worker-2 -> worker-1 first, then monitor. Command I'm running: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=42 -n prod-us-east
```

infra_sre: ack. I am tailing logs and metrics, will validate errors drop below 1% before we close the war room.

incident-bot: Pager escalation to L2 (infra_sre) after 5m if no recovery.

leo_oncall: rollback initiated, pod replacement in progress (pods terminating/creating). ETA ~3-5m. Posting status page draft now:
"Investigating: We are investigating intermittent 500 errors affecting the text generation API in US-East. We have identified a recent deployment as a potential cause and have initiated a rollback. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or when the situation changes."

rachel_pm: small wording tweak: change "initiated a rollback" -> "rolling back a recent deployment to mitigate errors".

leo_oncall: updated status page text per @rachel_pm and published.

infra_sre: metrics update: error rate trending down -> 3.2% currently. KV cache miss rate normalizing on worker-1.

sam_support: notifying top 10 active customers with the approved template, will include status page link.

leo_oncall: handing off active monitoring to infra_sre for follow-up at 1772468120. I'll remain reachable for escalation. War room remains open until error rate <1% for 10m.

emma: noted. Logging action items for postmortem: 1) validate deploy gating on cache warmup 2) refine rollback automation 3) improve status page cadence template.

infra_sre: will capture logs and metrics for postmortem. Continuing to monitor. :white_check_mark:
